identity.name: Overseas Chronograph

case.bezel: six-sided, derived from the Maltese cross

identity.one_liner: The Overseas chronograph on Vacheron's in-house column-wheel caliber 5200, with the line's three-way strap system.

provenance_events.description: Vacheron's Overseas Chronograph ref. 5500V is released alongside the 4500V at the 2016 Overseas relaunch — the brand's first chronograph in the Overseas line since 1999.

narrative.story: Launched with the 2016 Overseas overhaul, the 5500V finally gave the collection's chronograph a manufacture movement: caliber 5200, column wheel, vertical clutch, 22k gold rotor, Geneva Seal. The 42.5mm case keeps the soft-iron dust cover tradition of anti-magnetic protection and ships with bracelet, leather and rubber, all tool-free. The blue-dial steel version is the collection's second pillar after the self-winding.
narrative.collector_notes: It is a thick watch — 13.7mm — and sits large; the reverse-panda and later dial colors trade behind the blue. Verify the strap kit is complete and the deployant matches both leather and rubber options.
